investment_strategy: Concentrate on durable A.I. platform leaders with clear monetization paths and fortress balance sheets, sized for a cautiously bullish 12–36 month outlook. With the VIX near 17 (moderate risk appetite) and 10Y yields elevated at ~4.6% (valuation headwind for long-duration growth), overweight lower-volatility hyperscalers (Microsoft, Alphabet) and add a smaller high-beta A.I. compute kicker (NVIDIA). Emphasize earnings quality, cash generation, and pricing power amid regulatory scrutiny, export controls, and supply/power constraints. Rebalance quarterly, add on pullbacks of 8–12% in core positions, and keep the satellite chip exposure capped given headline risk.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility, strong earnings/revenue growth, positive momentum, and STRONG_BUY consensus; sized weights by risk (VIX ~17), rate sensitivity (10Y ~4.6%), trend, and regulatory/export headwinds.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously bullish over 12–36 months: generative A.I. monetization, data center and power buildouts drive leaders; expect bouts of volatility from antitrust actions, export controls, and high-rate sensitivity—favor cash-rich hyperscalers and maintain disciplined position sizing.
